name: MusicFin: Smarter Music Tagging
description: Context-based album assignment for Jellyfin music libraries (Deezer, MusicBrainz, iTunes, Discogs, or Open Opus).
overview: Fixes album names, track numbers, years, and genres using artist-wide overlap matching.
changelog: Prefer album coverage ratio over raw hit count; keep base albums when bonus tracks are owned as singles (Dreamland / TobyMac Collection fixes).
